fusions.name: Tug and Tear
fusions.desc: Seizes the target with your weapon and tears, dealing 10 damage and making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Snagging Threads
fusions.desc: Rips through a cone 2.5 tiles ahead for 7 damage, with a 35% chance each to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bandage Fetch
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second for 6 seconds to the ally who needs it most.

fusions.name: Mended by the Pack
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, healing on you is 30% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
